MY FIT architecture codec provenance

The browser add-ons and codec builds in this folder were taken from the pinned
Three.js 0.180.0 npm package, examples/jsm. The imports of Three.js and add-on
dependencies were changed to sibling paths so that they run under GitHub Pages.

Three.js add-ons: DRACOLoader.js, KTX2Loader.js, WorkerPool.js, ColorSpaces.js,
Reflector.js. License: MIT, supplied in THREE-LICENSE.txt.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180/examples/jsm

Draco decoder wasm and its JavaScript wrapper: Google Draco, Apache-2.0.
Copyright 2016 Google Inc. The Apache-2.0 license text is supplied in
BASIS-APACHE-2.txt and also applies to this decoder distribution.
https://github.com/google/draco

Basis Universal transcoder wasm and wrapper: Binomial LLC, Apache-2.0.
License text supplied in BASIS-APACHE-2.txt.
https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal

KTX parse and ZSTD decoder retain the notices in their upstream Three.js
distribution files.
